card.name: Space or digit just before a dose number
card.fires_on: The blank space or first digit right before a dose amount or percentage, as in 'is <space>62.5 mcg' or 'or <1>0 mg'. It also fires on a few words like 'yield' and 'greater' that lead into 'more' or 'higher' results.

modes.label: Space before a number
modes.description: A lone space token that comes right before a dose or percentage figure.

modes.description: The first digit of a dose or dose range, where the next digit is still to come.

modes.label: Words leading to more or greater
modes.description: A verb or adjective that introduces a comparison of effects.
modes.example: there was a general trend for<< greater>> effects with higher doses

card.writes: Promoted and suppressed tokens are mixed and unrelated, so there is no clear output effect.
card.plain: It lights up just before a dose number is written, when the next piece is a digit.
